bot.upload_start_welcome:
Welcome to the Upload Bot

1. Single upload: send a file directly to generate a file code

2. Batch upload (all files share one file code):
  /start_upload — start batch upload
  send multiple files...
  /end_upload — finish and generate file code

3. Collection packing (pack multiple file codes into one collection code):
  /new_collection — start collection packing
  send file codes (can be appended multiple times)...
  /end_collection — generate collection code
  /cancel_collection — cancel collection packing
  /note_collection text — add a note

All users can upload files for free
Send /help for full help
bot.upload_banned: You are banned from using the upload feature
bot.batch_upload_started:
Batch upload mode activated. Please send files.
Send /end_upload to finish and generate file code.
Send /cancel_upload to cancel this upload.

Use /note text to add a note for this batch
bot.collection_packing_started:
Collection packing mode activated. Please send file codes (can be appended).
Send /end_collection to generate collection code.
Send /cancel_collection to cancel collection packing.
Send /note_collection text to add a note
